author: Hdgggggggg

content: The times allowed for the levels are too short. Less than 3 min for big complex scenes full of obstacles you need to clear before you can select the required items. I wish there was an untimed option. The game is very stingy with rewards and powerups too. I get one or two small powerups for every 10 levels I finish. Mostly I have to replay each level several times and memorize all the objects before I can pass. Even then I’m rushing and praying I don’t click one wrong item even once otherwise I’ve already lost. They also don’t reward enough coins to help at all, my coin bank is constantly empty and I feel like I used coins to buy more time maybe a handful of times max in 250 levels. I found other versions of this same game that allow a lot more time, have better rewards, fewer ads, and aren’t telling you you’re a loser who needs to spend $50 on a powerup package every 2.5 minutes to keep collecting little babies and donkeys from the cartoon world kids game. Also, lastly, if you’re looking for a game that matches the images from this listing in the App Store, bad news. The black and white drawing images of the game posted here are all taken from the mini game bonus from the main game. That is not the main game, which is all color animated city scenes that look identical to many other games in the App Store, and not what you will be playing 90% of the time.

author: missuszettas
title: Well…..
content:
This is game is great. I love nearly everything about this game. 

Excellent graphics, camaraderie with teammates/free lives, variety in levels however, this game is set up for you to either have to spend money for goodies to pass every fourth or fifth level or spend an enormous amount of time on that level until you’ve magically developed Superman skills (which for most of us is very unlikely) simply out of insane boredom of failing the same level over and over again and a desire to progress in the game.

$6 gets you basically nothing and the next tier, $20 is a close second to not much.

I would happily spend a monthly membership fee or play more minigames (they do not offer enough) to grab a hold of helpful items but they do not offer.

Spending $100 every month to get past near impossible levels only to begin again within hours, is worse than a gambling addiction. 

I understand supporting the game, the devs, etc. but there’s a better way. I think in the long run more people will stop playing because it’s expensive when they could have more people wanting to play if it were affordable.

And the error is not because my finger is somewhat wide and I may have accidentally tapped the wrong item. I use an Apple Pencil so there is very little room for error.   I t’s possible this could be sloppy programming, not mapping the tableau accurately, but the end result is the same; it doesn’t give you what you selected. I’ll wait for a response from the developers before deleting this game. Too bad, it’s otherwise a fun game!
